According to Source [S1], the 'Default direct atomics' method has a mean time of 2.86811 ms. This time is indeed faster (lower) than warp-private histograms (3.32800 ms) and block-local hash aggregation (2.92911 ms). However, it is slower (higher) than two-stage aggregation (2.85863 ms), as 2.86811 > 2.85863. Therefore, the claim that it is faster than *all* three listed methods is factually incorrect regarding two-stage aggregation.
